title: Evidence for the Play-policy finding: plain SOCKS5/HTTP expose credentials, hostnames and payload.
requirement: Google Play VpnService policy (encrypt device-to-tunnel-endpoint traffic).

checks.check: SOCKS5 plain: password visible on the network (RFC 1929 is cleartext)
SOCKS5 plain: app payload of a non-TLS app visible
HTTP plain: CONNECT line with hostname visible

notes: Contrast with test_E04 valid-* cases, where none of these appear on the wire.
